## Plume forcing: accepted by the parser, never installed (`forcing/plume-forcing`) {#sec-ch09-plume}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0 (chengcli/snapy)
sources: OUTLINE.md 9.10; src/forcing/plume_forcing.cpp; src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp; src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp
status: draft
-->

`PlumeForcingImpl::forward` ([`plume_forcing.cpp:29-41`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/forcing/plume_forcing.cpp#L29-L41)) adds entrainment and buoyancy sources for a
one-dimensional plume model whose primitive vector is radius, vertical velocity, buoyancy and a fourth variable,
with options `entrainment` (default 0.1) and `N2` (default 0). The key `plume-forcing` is on the list
`check_keys` accepts ([`hydro_options.cpp:73-76`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp#L73-L76)), but its options are parsed and the module is installed
only when the equation of state is `plume-eos` ([`hydro_options.cpp:116-119`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp#L116-L119),
[`register_forcing_modules.cpp:77-81`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/register_forcing_modules.cpp#L77-L81)), and `EquationOfStateImpl::create` refuses that type as unknown
([`equation_of_state.cpp:356-375`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L356-L375); the plume EOS was removed in chengcli/snapy#282). So at the pin a deck
with `plume-forcing:` is accepted and the key has no effect, and no test exercises the module; it is dead code and
this report does not describe it further. chengcli/snapy#217 still lists it among the valid keys.
